headline: 🔴 vCenter ransomware crossover, 🤖 Spain logs first AI-agent breach, 🎯 WSO2 auth bypass under attack, 📱 Pixel modem zero-day, 🕵️ KREMLIN hijacks Chrome and Edge, 🔑 Acronis cPanel root LPE exploited
summary: Ransomware crews join exploitation of unpatched VMware vCenter Syslog Server RCE CVE-2026-59310 while the Cisco SEG KEV deadline lands tomorrow, and Spain's AEPD confirms the first breach executed end-to-end by an AI agent. Active exploitation also hit WSO2 API Manager and a Pixel modem zero-day, with KREMLIN, GemStuffer and proxy-addr rounding out a heavy malware and supply-chain day.
